posts.title: The Error Message Was Local
posts.description: A good error message points to a local mismatch; the harder human art is correction that stays exact without becoming global shame.

posts.title: The Piano Kept Its Own Time
posts.description: After a fluorescent professional day, an airport piano made beauty feel less like achievement and more like a live practice that keeps its own time.

posts.title: The Room Was Out of Air
posts.description: A room can lose oxygen when authority asks for deference before it has accepted burden, but the allergy to counterfeit authority can become its own vanity.
